subject: CAIQ subcontrol samples — workshop & evidence list
messages:
From: Alex Morton <sec@sigmahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: EVA Consulting <eva@consulting.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Clarifying CAIQ subcontrol samples for upcoming review

Hi Priyom,

Hope you're doing well. As part of Sigma Health's procurement security review we want to validate a subset of CAIQ controls focused on runtime isolation, telemetry and key management. Our security team asked for a small set of representative artifacts for the controls below so we can complete the CSA review ahead of contract approval: 

- CCM:INF-1 / Isolation (runtime logs or tenant routing config)
- CCM:LOG-3 / Telemetry retention (sample telemetry export, retention policy snippet)
- CCM:KEY-2 / Key management (KMS usage statement, rotation schedule)

Can you confirm whether you can provide sample artifacts (not full production dumps) and a short crosswalk that maps your CAIQ assertions to these controls? Ideally we'd get drafts by Tuesday (Nov 25) to stay on schedule. If it's easier, we'd be happy to do a 30-minute workshop where you can show where the artifacts live and which teams own each piece.

Also please indicate who on your side will be the owner(s) for evidence delivery.

Thanks,
Alex Morton
Security Review Lead, Sigma Health
sec@sigmahealth.com

--
Attachment: initial-question-set.pdf (pdf)
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morton <sec@sigmahealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, EVA Consulting <eva@consulting.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarifying CAIQ subcontrol samples for upcoming review

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide representative artifacts and a CAIQ crosswalk for the items you listed. To keep this lightweight and auditable I propose: 

1) 30-minute walkthrough (shared screen) where we show the exact log export steps and config screenshots.
2) Deliver a small artifact bundle (redacted) that includes: 
   - caiq-assertion-index.xlsx: mapping of assertions->controls->owner
   - prod-telemetry-sample.log: 7-day sample (redacted PII)
   - kv-cache-config-screenshot.png: runtime isolation config snippet
   - short statement on KMS rotation and an excerpt from the rotation policy
3) Single point of contact: Kimberly Park (CC'd) for technical artifacts; Neha (CC'd) for compliance/DocuSign and delivery logistics.

Propose the workshop today at 2:00pm PT or tomorrow morning if that works better for your team. If you prefer a drop-and-review flow we can also send the bundle via a secure Drive link + DocuSign attestation for chain-of-custody.

Let me know which slot you prefer and we'll get the artifacts staged.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

--
Attachment stubs: caiq-assertion-index.xlsx (xlsx), prod-telemetry-sample.log (log)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morton <sec@sigmahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, EVA Consulting <eva@consulting.io>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarifying CAIQ subcontrol samples for upcoming review

On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 10:08 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide representative artifacts and a CAIQ crosswalk for the items you listed.

Thanks Priyom — quick technical notes so Alex knows what we'll stage: 

- Isolation (CCM:INF-1): I'll capture a tenant routing extraction and a runtime affinity screenshot. The file will be named kv-cache-config-screenshot.png and will include the routing policy and instance assignment table with IDs redacted.
- Telemetry (CCM:LOG-3): prod-telemetry-sample.log will be a 7-day sample (rotated, rate-limited) with all user identifiers hashed. We'll include the retention_policy.md excerpt that shows the 90-day retention for aggregated telemetry and 365-day retention for security logs.
- KMS (CCM:KEY-2): Short statement (kms-rotation-statement.txt) that covers automated rotation schedule, CMK tagging, and HSM-backed key usage for dedicated/private deployments.

I'll be the technical owner for artifact generation and will coordinate with SRE to pull the log sample. ETA for staging the bundle into a secure drive folder is by 1:30pm PT today if we run the 2pm workshop.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Principal SRE, Reductions & Runtime
kimberly@redwood.com

--
Attachment stubs: kv-cache-config-screenshot.png (png), retention_policy.md (md)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morton <sec@sigmahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarifying CAIQ subcontrol samples for upcoming review

Alex / team — confirming the 2:00pm PT slot works for us and I've booked a calendar invite (please accept). For delivery options: we will put the artifact bundle in a restricted Google Drive folder and share a time-limited link, then send a DocuSign attestation that the package is a representative sample.

Drive folder (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink
DocuSign envelope: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/example-envelope-id

Attachments that will appear in the folder: 
- caiq-assertion-index.xlsx
- prod-telemetry-sample.log (redacted)
- kv-cache-config-screenshot.png
- kms-rotation-statement.txt
- retention_policy.md

If you need us to redact additional fields before upload please tell us which fields to remove (we can run a hash-only export). Looking forward to the walkthrough — Kim will drive the demo.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
